title: Frequent Overpayment Notices Shorten a Repayment Plan (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, an agreement that keeps drawing overpayment notices repays its repayment plan over fewer claim payment runs.

**Clause.** The plan notice-frequency reduction of the plan run count is set by the agreement's overpayment notices dated fewer than 12 whole months before today:

- 5 or more remove 4 runs;
- 3 or more but fewer than 5 remove 2 runs;
- fewer than 3 remove nothing.

## Counting

- Count every overpayment notice on the agreement whose notice date is fewer than 12 whole months before today, whatever has since happened to it.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the notice date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the notice date's day of the month.

## Table

| Notices in the window | Runs removed |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | None |
| 3 or 4 | 2 |
| 5 or more | 4 |

**Hypothetical.** An agreement has six notices in all, four of them within the last 12 whole months, so 2 runs are removed.
